20:126.text: (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
came unto you, but you disregarded them
(i.e. you left them, did not think deeply in them, and you turned away from them)
, and so this Day, you will be neglected
(in the Hell-fire, away from Allâh’s Mercy)

20:127.text: And thus do We requite him who transgresses beyond bounds
[i.e. commits the great sins and disobeys his Lord (Allâh) and believes not in His Messengers, and His revealed Books, like this Qur’an]
, and believes not in the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of his Lord; and the torment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting.

20:128.text: Is it not a guidance for them
how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose dwellings they walk? Verily, in this are signs indeed for men of understanding.

20:129.text: And had it not been for a Word that went forth before from your Lord, and a term determined,

20:130.text: what they say, and glorify the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before its setting, and during some hours of the night, and at the ends of the day
(an indication for the five compulsory congregational prayers)
(with the reward which Allâh shall give you)

20:131.text: And strain not your eyes in longing for the things We have given for enjoyment to various groups of them
(polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)
, the splendour of the life of this world, that We may test them thereby. But the provision
of your Lord is better and more lasting.

20:132.text: on your family, and be patient in offering them
. We ask not of you a provision
: We provide for you. And the good end

20:133.text: They say: "Why does he not bring us a sign
from his Lord?" Has there not come to them the proof of that which is
[Scriptures, i.e. the Taurât (Torah), and the Injeel (Gospel), about the coming of the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]

20:134.text: And if We had destroyed them with a torment before this
(i.e. Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân)
, they would surely have said: "Our Lord! If only You had sent us a Messenger, we should certainly have followed Your Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
, before we were humiliated and disgraced."

20:135.text: is waiting, so wait you too; and you shall know who are they that are on the Straight and Even Path
, and who are they that have let themselves be guided
